result:
US March AP and expense review is complete. Summary of what I found and did:

**Fixed (3 entries posted):**

1. **Duplicate vendor bill — $31,148.20.** Stackline Cloud invoice STA-98877 was posted twice (JE-00232 and JE-00241) against the *same* support doc, with only one invoice and one payment. Reversed JE-00241 via **JE-00307**, and since it exceeds the $10k senior accountant limit, routed it to the controller with an approval request per Policy §1 — it's pending.

2. **Miscoding — $3,880.00.** JE-00250 was booked to Meals & Entertainment with memo "team dinner," but the invoice (DOC-0172) is Northgate **Data Centers** colocation for March. Reclassed to 5000 Hosting & Infrastructure via **JE-00308** (under threshold, no approval needed).

3. **Omitted expense — $65.00.** The 3/31 bank service charge on the statement had no ledger entry. Recorded via **JE-00309**.

**Escalated (2 exceptions):**

- **EXC-001 — $6,750 "Legal retainer" (JE-00288).** Posted manually with *no support*; the bank line reads only "WIRE OUT ACCT ENDING 7731" with no payee, and no legal invoice or engagement letter exists anywhere in the document store. I deliberately did **not** post a reclass or a reversal — I can't support the classification either way, and reversing would break the cash rec. Recommended to the controller: identify the payee, and if unidentified by close, move it to 2900 Suspense (also noted it may belong in prepaid under Policy §4 if it truly is a retainer).
- **EXC-002 — $149.90 Zoom double charge on 3/08.** Both charges genuinely cleared the bank with receipts, so the ledger is correct and I made no adjustment — flagged as a vendor billing issue to pursue a credit.

**Clean:** all 12 card entries tie one-to-one to receipts and bank lines with sensible coding; all recurring AP bills agree to invoice and are coded correctly; all payments trace to bank; no unrecorded March-service invoices, so no cutoff accrual needed. Marked "AP cutoff review" complete.

One thing worth your attention that sits **outside** March: AP carries ~$96,300 forward from 2/28 with zero February activity, leaving mostly aged pre-March payables in the $100,180 balance at 3/31. Jan/Feb are closed so I made no adjustment, but the AP subledger should be reconciled to the GL — it may contain items already paid.
